changes.before_source_text:
Dior J'adore L'Or Essence de Parfum for Women is a luxurious and opulent fragrance that embodies the essence of floral grandeur. Designed by Francis Kurkdjian, this perfume is a testament to the craftsmanship of Dior's fragrance creation. It features an exquisite composition of floral notes, primarily centered around orange blossom, jasmine grandiflorum, and centifolia rose absolutes. These core ingredients blend to create a voluptuous and powerful scent that evokes the imagery of pure, liquid gold.
The fragrance opens with the bright and fresh tones of orange blossom, lending it an elegant and feminine charm. The heart of the perfume is dominated by jasmine grandiflorum, known for its strong yet subtle fragrance with nuances of almond, mango, and banana, providing a unique fruity florality. The centifolia rose adds a compelling depth with its full and rich aroma, enhancing the overall composition's luxurious feel.
The bottle design complements the scent's opulence, inspired by Christian Dior's figure-eight motif. It features a flowing metallic gold necklace that elegantly embraces the glass bottle, reflecting the fragrance's warmth and intensity.
J'adore L'Or is more than just a fragrance; it's a symbol of femininity and sophistication, making it a perfect choice for those who appreciate the artistry behind a well-crafted perfume.

Escentric Molecules Molecule 04 is a soft, creamy sandalwood skin scent.
Geza Schoen created it in 2017. Built around sandalwood, it is smooth, powdery and warm, sitting close to the skin with a quiet glow.
Calm and easy, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym from spring through fall.

"Molecule instead of mass: "Less" is often "more" in the world of perfumes. At the heart of Escentric Molecules 04 is the molecule Javanol, which takes sandalwood into a new dimension. Molecule 04 contains pure Javanol, Escentric 04 surrounds it with aromas of grapefruit." - a note from the brand.

changes.before_source_text:
Etat Libre d'Orange Divin'Enfant is a sweet, powdery blend of marshmallow, orange flower and tobacco.
Antoine Lie created it in 2006. Leather, marshmallow, orange flower, tobacco, rose, amber, musk, coffee and tonka bean come together in a soft, sweet and slightly animalic scent.
Cozy and playful, it is a great daytime scent in fall and winter.

A child can either charm or annoy us with the same ruthlessness. A child can be irresistible with his angel-sweet smile but he also knows how to drive us crazy. Under the angel, the faked innocence of a demon. After the gentle top notes of orange blossom and marshmallow, breaks the unexpected accord of coffee, leather and cold tobacco, a shrilling symbol of our sleepless nights. True to his reputation of «polymorphic pervert», this mini-sized tyrant is only happy when he succeeds in imposing his whims, which he always manages to do.What a sweet little monster !
Composition: Orange blossom, marshmallow, rose, moka, leather, amber, musk, tobacco

changes.before_source_text:
Initio High Frequency is a bright, airy floral with almond and magnolia.
Launched in 2016, it opens with hedione, almond and magnolia. Almond returns in the heart for a soft, nutty sweetness, and hedione keeps it light and radiant to the end.
Fresh and uplifting, it is great for everyday wear in spring, fall and winter.

An uncompromising fragrance that’s
rich in hedione- the aromatic ingredient proven to increase excitement
and desire. High frequency reveals itself like a sound wave that starts
soft and amps up on the skin, magnolia and almond melding in a way
that’s overtly innocent yet surprisingly sensual- as if the whole world
was vibrating on a higher plane that only a fortunate few can tap into.
High Frequency  Notes
Magnolia, almond, hedione

changes.before_source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Vitae is a bright blend of lemon, mandarin and vanilla.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2013. Lemon, Sicilian mandarin, jasmine and hedione open sparkling, and guaiac wood, tonka bean and a vanilla infusion give it a warm, woody finish.
Fresh and uplifting, it is great for everyday wear, the office and the gym in summer.

The Scoop
It was one afternoon on Formentera, in the Balearic Islands, that the idea of Aqua Vitae came to my mind.
Riding an old motorbike, taking it slowly in view of the extreme
heat, the air on my face was deliciously cool. The sun intensified the
fragrances of the nature around me. Aqua Vitae, the water of life, when
life is quite simply beautiful, an extremely sensitive sensuality
enveloped with an uncontained freshness. — Francis Kurkdjian
Kurkdjian's gorgeous ode to a summer afternoon opens with a
sparkling combination of Calabrian lemon and Sicilian mandarin, evoking
the sensual fullness of “uncontained freshness.” Dazzling Hedione adds
with the warmth of the sun while waves of tonka bean and vanilla counter
with a cooling breeze.
In its final phase, Aqua Vitae softens to a sunkissed, sandy
drydown. By no means is it a fresh dab of coppertone - no beachy coconut
here, but rather a whisper of vanilla-sweetened guaiac lingering close
to the skin. It's a gentle reminder of summer afternoon caught on the
skin, still warm from the sun.
Aqua Vitae  Notes
Lemon, mandarin, tonka bean, vanilla infusion, hedione and guaiac wood

changes.before_source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Gold is a warm, creamy take on juniper, vanilla and musk.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2019. Juniper, nutmeg and coriander open soft and spicy, then vanilla, amber and musks wrap it in a smooth, golden warmth.
Comforting and polished, it is lovely for spring, fall and winter days.

Working the ingredient to express its full potential and meeting the
challenge of composing two different eaux de parfum with the same notes:
juniper berries, nutmeg, coriander, musks, ambery woods and vanilla.
The Gentle Fluidity duo was born of the perfumer’s imagination to offer
two distinct olfactory silhouettes, for her or for him.
In gentle Fluidity’s (gold) generous, enveloping trail, we can find
coriander seed essence and an overdose of musks and vanilla. The floral,
spicy note of coriander seeds brings, just like musks, ethereal volume
and a lingering trail. In the base notes, the gourmand, reassuring notes
of the vanilla accord enhanced by the ambery woods reveal a radiant,
bright silhouette.

changes.before_source_text:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Silver is a fresh, aromatic take on juniper, spice and musk.
Francis Kurkdjian created it in 2019. Juniper berries and coriander open crisp and bright, nutmeg adds a dry spice, and musks, ambery woods and vanilla leave a clean, comfortable trail.
Gentle Fluidity Silver is clean, bright and quietly sophisticated, with a gin-like freshness. It is an easy everyday scent for spring and summer days and works for everyone.

Working the ingredient to express its full potential and meeting the
challenge of composing two different eaux de parfum with the same notes:
juniper berries, nutmeg, coriander, musks, ambery woods and vanilla.
The Gentle Fluidity duo was born of the perfumer’s imagination to offer
two distinct olfactory silhouettes, for her or for him.
In Gentle fluidity (silver), nutmeg and ambery woods are dominant and
release a vibrant, comfortable trail. As for juniper berry essence, it
leads to an ascending, ultra-fresh, aromatic note, similar to a “gin
frappé” effect, balanced by the dry, slightly balmy, spicy notes of
nutmeg. The base notes reveal ambery wood facets ranging from sweet and
enveloping to powerful and dry.

changes.before_source_text:
Roja Parfums Enigma Pour Homme is a rich blend of cognac, tobacco and vanilla.
Roja Dove created it in 2019. Bergamot opens the way to heliotrope, jasmine, neroli, rose and geranium, then cognac, vanilla, benzoin, tobacco, ginger, ambergris and sandalwood give it a warm, boozy and spicy depth.
Luxurious and inviting, it is made for fall and winter, day or night.

“Shrouded in a swirl of Cognac and Tobacco, a suave figure sits cool
and composed at the bar of a private members’ club - where the scent of
Woods and Leather pervade. Dressed in a way that defies the club rules,
this alluring presence is definitely unexpected. Why is he here? How did
he get in? You cannot take your eye off this mysterious man. Warm
touches of spice blend with soft Vanilla and Benzoin, which create a
sense of ambiguity - nothing is quite what it seems.” - a note from the
brand.
Enigma Pour Homme Parfum Cologne was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Roja Dove.
